top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Provide at least one room set aside to use as a resident dining room and for activities, that is a good size, with good lighting, air flow and furniture.
Keep residents' personal and medical records private and confidential.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
